Q: Is my Trail Stove TS-2 affected?
A: Yes. All TS-2 units have a defective valve and must stop being used immediately.
Q: How do I get a replacement?
A: Email us your order number.

arguments.title: Trail Stove Recall FAQ
arguments.body:
# Trail Stove Recall FAQ

Q: Is my Trail Stove TS-2 affected?
A: Yes. All TS-2 units have a defective valve and must stop being used immediately.

Q: How do I get a replacement?
A: Email us your order number.
